odds.$description: The odds/coefficient value and its live-movement behaviour. Static = text.default, tabular-nums, any string (decimal 2.83 or fractional 199/200 — not a parser). When a new price arrives the app toggles the up/down modifier: the value flashes text.positive (up) or text.negative (down) and, while the change is fresh, the previous price shows struck-through beside it; over `movement.duration` the highlight eases back to text.default and the old value fades out (a single self-reverting CSS animation — the component owns the colours, the strike and the timing, the app owns only the trigger, and drops the previous-value node once the animation ends). prefers-reduced-motion: no flash — the changed value simply holds its up/down colour with the previous value shown, so the change is still legible without motion. Size is contextual (set where the odds is used — 14px on a bet card, larger in the summary); this component fixes only the numeric styling + movement, defaulting to heading-base.

type.$description: 14px semibold default — matches the bet card's odds. tabular-nums is applied in CSS. Override font-size in context for a larger summary value.

gap.$description: 6px between the new value and the struck-through previous one.

up.$description: Drifted up — the positive/green highlight the value flashes to.

color.$description: The struck-through previous price — muted grey, line-through, shown beside the new value until the movement animation ends.

duration.$description: How long the up/down highlight holds before easing back to text.default and fading the previous value out. A token — set to the product's live-feed cadence (the reference reads ~3–5s).
